reviews.title: These special edition cameras are tiny but powerful!
reviews.comment: I was using Nexigo 4k and it struggled to blend the green screen around my edges and so I bought 2 of these to replace my 2 4k cameras. The 4k cams served me well, but this 1080p cam just gets a clearer quality. When I was replacing the 4k cam, I hooked both cams up and used them as reference checks for when I was adjusting my out of the box ObsBot camera software settings. If you need something with a stable image and is easy to install and it just functions and autofocuses for you really well and can blend with the green screen to give you really good quality, then you should definitely pick these up because the price is super great for this level of quality. What I'm trying to say is that this camera looks better than my 4k camera did and it's not even close in comparison. I got a slightly sharper image with the 4k camera but it just struggled with the green screen and sudden movement when I dance around during my DJ live sets, and this one does not. And it works great for gaming, too. But, I cannot really attached for the sound quality because I don't use it for that I have my own mic for all that, but from what I did see is that it was clear but like I said I just use my own mic. You should definitely get this camera because it's super cheap and it's super powerful! Upgrade your stream!
reviews.author: LIATA

reviews.title: Item delivered unexpectedly early.
reviews.comment: I was looking for options to upgrade my webcam & setup for possibly streaming. Later while browsing, I saw a content creator via YouTube recommending the 2nd version of this web cam, which I was inclined to buy. But to test the waters before making a bigger investment, I opted to get the earlier version instead. I submitted the payment and then, the item arrived 2 days earlier, a pleasant surprise indeed. The quality is nice, and its interface is easy to follow, just as the content creator explained in his video. Compact and super lightweight, with built in magnets, also has the option for a tripod if you have one, plenty of ways to use. 2 connection options, USB & USB-C. The lighting was a pleasant surprise plus the 1080p resolution looks crisp and clean. So far, I'm very pleased with the product. Will buy again from this brand in the near future.
reviews.author: Pablo Ortiz

reviews.title: Outstanding visuals for the price, Gestures work without software, Great mount
reviews.comment: This camera is wonderful for what it costs. If you're looking to get a webcam, if you need a camera for streaming/content creation, get this one, it'll get you what you need without costing you an arm and a leg. A lot of cameras can have diminishing returns the more you spend, and this feels like it's right at the point of spending the amount of money for the quality you're getting, rather than overspending for less and less benefit over time. The mount for the camera is great, and it holds it onto the monitor well without easily slipping, although make sure you're careful when you grab the camera lens cover, because if you're too rough with it, it'll definitely fall off. You won't need any tools or skills to install this thing, it's as easy as the marketing materials claim. The lens cover doesn't scratch the lens at all, even though it's made of metal, so that's a plus. It also magnetizes well to the bottom of the mount when it's not in use. The microphone quality is okay, but if you want actually good quality sound, get a dedicated mic. This looks better than any other webcam I've tried in my life, and it does a decent job at representing the actual color of things in the picture, whether that be objects in the background or human skin. It works well in both high and low light situations. The hand gestures for zooming in and out, and following a subject w/zoom both work without any software needed, which is AMAZING for someone who doesn't like installing tons of software just to use features on their own hardware. (although additional features past that are going to require their dedicated software) However, make sure your lighting allows it to work properly. I've found that top-down lighting that leaves a shadow across your hand can cause the gestures to not work, so make sure you have some front-facing light to illuminate your entire palm if you want to use the gesture controls. It works on every computer/laptop I've tried it on, running both Windows and Linux, so that's nice as well. The included USB C-C cable is more than long enough, and works perfectly as expected, no notes on that. It's definitely a great camera for the price, and I think 99% of people won't need anything better than this in terms of camera quality. I don't think I'm going to be the best person to show you the actual visual quality considering the lighting and space I have available to me though, so I'd suggest looking up some videos on YouTube with shots from this camera in different lighting setups, since that should give you a much better idea of its quality.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: The Perfect Cute Camera for Streamers (it overheats easy tho)
reviews.comment: Extremely versatile, insanely high quality picture wrapped into a tiny, easy to use camera. It even works well in the dark! I use it for vtubing and rarely need extra light! And for all it does, it was not too expensive; I feel like I got a really good camera for a really good price! The little magnetic stand it comes with is super convenient! edit: still a wonderful cam, but it overheats easily while in use, and is noticeably warm even when it is "off" (meaning you should maybe leave it unplugged until you actually need to use it, so you can get whatever extra minutes of non-overheated time you can)
reviews.author: Percy

reviews.title: Insanely good camera.
reviews.comment: I've been buying Amazon products for over a decade, probably spent hundreds of thousands of dollars, and have made almost no reviews, but I felt I needed to leave one because this camera is ridiculously good. I bought multiple web cameras and they all seem poor in one regard or another. I don't know all the technical details about cameras. I know I've just bought a bunch over the years and they don't seem to be that great. I plugged this one in and it is distinctly superior in resolution, realistic color balance, and the like. It's like a high-quality movie camera for a very small price. It's super small too, like the size of a small matchbox. Anyway I don't know how these people make money because it's just so good. I just bought another one for a friend tonight.
